/-- Helper: 6! < 3^6 (base case verification) -/

/-- Helper: For all n ≥ 7, n! ≥ 3^n -/
theorem factorial_ge_pow_three_of_n_ge_7 (n : ℕ) (h : n ≥ 7) : 
    Nat.factorial n ≥ 3 ^ n := by sorry

/-- Main theorem: p10_answer is the greatest element of {n : ℕ | n ! < 3 ^ n} -/
